hypothesis: The PGO-improved Rust toolchain that reduced IronRDP build time also reduces wall-clock compilation time across the frozen broader corpus.
contrast: Exact IronRDP 1.94.1 toolchain replacement: official shipping base versus qualified local PGO-repair/native-linking test; not PGO-on versus PGO-off or pure profile causality.
rustdoc_pin_basis: New explicit hash from the verified official 1.94.1 rustc archive whose rustc/driver match the historical baseline; historical replay indexes did not record rustdoc hashes.

measurement.pairing: round, scenario, adjacent base/test variants; native_ci_probe.paired_order by replicate and round
measurement.machine_scope: Five independent windows-2025 jobs per project; different projects do not share machines. Both variants and all scenarios run on each project's machine.
measurement.cold: Unique empty target directory for every cell, not an OS page-cache flush. Cargo fetch and metadata outside timing.
measurement.incremental: Fresh target seeded by that variant outside timing; no-op and comment-only edit are separate endpoints.
measurement.correctness: Every original command, unfiltered, for each variant/scenario in the warmup round outside timing. Measured rows link to their exact successful warmup evidence; no tests are claimed for those rows.
measurement.cleanup: Only each successful cell's target and correctness-target directories, after evidence/source verification and outside timing. Retain all result/log files and failed evidence.
measurement.profiles: Preserve workload profiles/features; common official Cargo/rustdoc/std, offline frozen inputs, four workers and four-CPU affinity.
measurement.memory_cpu: Whole command-tree CPU and fresh Windows Job peak committed memory are secondary diagnostics, not rustc-only CPU or RSS.

analysis.cell_estimate: Average three measured rounds within each machine/variant, then ratio of equally weighted machine means; reduction = 1 - test/base.
analysis.family_estimate: Equal-project geometric mean of the three project ratios for each scenario family; no combined full/incremental headline.
analysis.resampling: Paired whole-machine bootstrap within each project; preserve both variants and every scenario for a selected machine. Sample independently across projects because their machines are distinct.
analysis.interpretation: 95% pointwise percentile intervals. A wholly positive reduction interval supports an improvement for that endpoint; wholly negative supports a slowdown; otherwise inconclusive. Report all cells/families and mixed outcomes.
analysis.exclusions: Only the one preplanned warmup round. Incomplete/failed/mixed-attempt matrices fail validation; preserve failure evidence. No slow-sample trimming or post-result project selection.
analysis.limits: Conditional on fixed compiler artifacts and selected roots; not retraining uncertainty, simultaneous intervals, strict dependency-disjointness, runtime/code-size safety or a shipping threshold.
